pairs: Announce his works among the nations.
Be praised in his holy name.
Let the heart of those who seek the Lord rejoice.
his portents and the judgments of his mouth:
you offspring of Abraham his servant,
you sons of Jacob his elect.
He is the Lord our God.
His judgments are throughout the entire earth.
Memor fuit in sæculum testamenti sui;
He has remembered his covenant for all ages:
verbi quod mandavit in mille generationes:
the word that he entrusted to a thousand generations,
et statuit illud Jacob in præceptum,
And he stationed the same for Jacob with a precept,
and for Israel with an eternal testament,
To you, I will give the land of Canaan,
Though they may have been but a small number,
Et pertransierunt de gente in gentem,
and though they passed from nation to nation,
et de regno ad populum alterum.
and from one kingdom to another people,
he allowed no man to harm them,
and he reproved kings on their behalf.
Do not be willing to touch my Christ,
et in prophetis meis nolite malignari.
and do not be willing to malign my prophets.
And he called a famine upon the land,
and he crushed every foundation of the bread.
He sent a man before them:
who had been sold as a slave.
They humbled his feet in shackles;
The eloquence of the Lord inflamed him.
he was the ruler of the people,
He established him as master of his house
and ruler of all his possessions,
ut erudiret principes ejus sicut semetipsum,
so that he might instruct his princes as himself,
et Jacob accola fuit in terra Cham.
and Jacob became a sojourner in the land of Ham.
And he helped his people greatly,
et firmavit eum super inimicos ejus.
and he strengthened them over their enemies.
Convertit cor eorum, ut odirent populum ejus,
He turned their heart to hate his people,
et dolum facerent in servos ejus.
and to deal deceitfully with his servants.
and Aaron, the one whom he chose.
Posuit in eis verba signorum suorum,
He placed with them signs of his word,
and portents in the land of Ham.
and he did not afflict them with his speech.
He turned their waters into blood,
Edidit terra eorum ranas in penetralibus regum ipsorum.
Their land brought forth frogs, even in the inner chambers of their kings.
and there came forth common flies and gnats,
et ciniphes in omnibus finibus eorum.
He gave them a shower of hail and a burning fire,
and he crushed the trees of their region.
et bruchus cujus non erat numerus:
and the caterpillar, of which there was no number.
et comedit omne fœnum in terra eorum,
And it devoured all the grass in their land,
et comedit omnem fructum terræ eorum.
and it consumed all the fruit of their land.
Et percussit omne primogenitum in terra eorum,
And he struck all the first-born in their land,
the first-fruits of all their labor.
Et eduxit eos cum argento et auro,
And he led them out with silver and gold,
et non erat in tribubus eorum infirmus.
and there was not an infirm one among their tribes.
Lætata est Ægyptus in profectione eorum,
Egypt was joyful at their departure,
quia incubuit timor eorum super eos.
for the fear of them lay heavy upon them.
He spread a cloud for their protection, and a fire,
et ignem ut luceret eis per noctem.
to give them light through the night.
and he satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
rivers gushed in the dry land.
Quoniam memor fuit verbi sancti sui,
For he had called to mind his holy word,
quod habuit ad Abraham puerum suum.
which he kept near to his servant Abraham.
Et eduxit populum suum in exsultatione,
And he led forth his people in exultation,
And he gave them the regions of the Gentiles,
and they possessed the labors of the peoples,
so that they might observe his justifications,
